regional_summary_6h.headline: Iran strike and Idlib landmine drive threat picture as Armenia-Russia diplomatic pressure builds
bullets: Iran dominates the window with a reported strike on wedding celebrations, signaling active kinetic risk near the Turkish border environment.

A landmine blast in Syria's Idlib injured four children while HALO Trust recorded nearly 700 war-remnant casualties in Syria so far in 2026, underscoring persistent civilian and humanitarian pressure.

Armenia faces simultaneous Russian pressure over a referendum on the EU, a Moscow refusal to hand over the Armenian railway concession, and domestic debate on the 39th parallel, while Bulgaria approved Russian-sanctions derogations for the Kozloduy and Belene reactors and met the NATO Assistant Secretary General for intelligence and security.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Watch for follow-on reporting on the Iran strike and any retaliatory signaling that could ripple across the region.
